clinical_industrial_research_use.value: Personal diabetes management (types 1, 2, gestational) with clinician oversight; OTC glucose tracking for non-insulin adults

consumables_service_attachment.value: Wearable disposable glucose sensors used with reusable apps/receiver; recurring sensor replacement; insurance-covered or direct online purchase

instrument_device_family.value: Continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) systems: Dexcom G7, G7 15 Day, and Stelo glucose biosensor

measurement_performance_specification.value: Real-time glucose readings every five minutes, customizable high/low alerts; company claims best-in-class accuracy

notes: Specific accuracy figures and calibration requirements are not in the evidence; G7 clearance details are inferred only from the iCGM wording for Stelo.

product_specific_regulatory_status.value: Stelo is an over-the-counter integrated CGM (iCGM); G7 carries indications, contraindications and instructions for use as a regulated medical device
